transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got four routine support visits scheduled for tomorrow — a vehicle-inspection team, a water-system contractor, a network-maintenance team, and a refrigerated repair-parts delivery. We need to assign each one to an entry point and a receiving window. Our available gates are Gate 1, Gate 2, Gate 3, and Service Gate 4, and the standard receiving windows are 0600, 0800, 1000, and 1300 — one visit per window. Before we finalize anything, I'd like to hear from each of you if you have any information or constraints I should know about regarding these visits, the gates, or the scheduling windows. Once we've settled on a plan, I'll sign it and get it posted to the guard desk and the receiving yard.
